description.zh: 要查询的专线网关实例的ID。
description.en: The ID of the Express Connect Router.

description.zh:
ECR实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID。

> 如果您要加载跨账号的网络实例，本参数必填。
description.en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account (main account) that owns the Express Connect Router.

> This parameter is required when querying a cross-account network instance.
The ID of the network instance.

description.zh:
要查询授权关系的实例类型。取值：

- **VBR**：边界路由器VBR（Virtual border router）实例，表示查询VBR实例拥有哪些VPC实例的授权。
- **VPC**：专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）实例，表示查询VPC实例对哪些VBR实例进行了授权。
description.en:
The type of instance whose authorization rules you want to query. Valid values:

- **VBR**: Set the value to **VBR** to query the Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) instances authorized to connect to the specified virtual border router (VBR).

- **VPC**: Set the value to **VPC** to query the VBRs to which the specified VPC has granted authorization.

description.zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：**1**~**100**，默认值为**100**。
description.en: The number of entries to return per page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **100**.

description.zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

* 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。

* 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的**NextToken**值。
description.en:
The token used to retrieve the next page of results. Valid values:

- Omit this parameter for the first request.

- For subsequent requests, set this to the **NextToken** value from the previous response.

description.zh: 要查询的网络实例所在的地域。
description.en: The ID of the region where the network instance is located.

description.zh: 要查询的网络实例所属的资源组ID。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the network instance belongs.
The tags. You can specify up to 20 tags.

description.zh:
资源的标签键。至少输入1个标签键，最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag key. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag value. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

title.zh: 查询专线网关跨账号授权信息
